name: card
title: Card
description: A card is a sheet of paper: header, title, description, action, content and footer with shadcn's spacing, on any stock and edge. Dividers are drawn pencil rules, and a card can be taped, pinned or clipped to the desk.

a11y: A Card is a plain div, as upstream: give it a role or an element (`as="article"`, `role="group"` with a label) when it means something more.
The sheet, dividers, tape and fasteners are aria-hidden decoration; nothing in them is focusable or takes pointer events.
Ink on paper is 14:1; muted descriptions 8.9:1. Text stays upright while the sheet turns, and the tilt is zero in calm density.
Calm density also draws a plain cut edge with a hairline shadow and hides tape and fasteners.
